# MemoTune

> AI music generator that turns personal stories into complete songs with lyrics and music. No music skills needed.

## Docs

- [MemoTune Homepage](https://memotune.com): AI music generation platform — create songs from text, lyrics, or images with 12 AI tools across 20+ genres.

## Products

- [AI Song Maker](https://memotune.com/ai-song-maker): Generate complete songs from text prompts or lyrics. Supports genre, mood, tempo controls with MP3/WAV export.
- [AI Lyrics Generator](https://memotune.com/ai-lyrics-generator): Create structured song lyrics (verses, choruses, bridges) from themes or stories in 8+ languages.
- [Lyrics to Song](https://memotune.com/lyrics-to-song): Convert existing lyrics into full musical tracks with melody, harmony, and instrumentation.
- [AI Cover](https://memotune.com/ai-cover): Transform songs into new genre covers (jazz, rock, electronic, acoustic) while preserving the original melody.
- [AI Vocal Remover](https://memotune.com/ai-vocal-remover): Separate vocals from instrumentals and split tracks into stems. Supports MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A input.
- [AI Singing Voice Generator](https://memotune.com/ai-singing-voice-generator): Train custom AI voice models from audio samples and generate realistic singing vocals from lyrics.
- [AI Voice Cover](https://memotune.com/ai-voice-cover): Apply AI voice models to existing songs to create personalized voice covers.
- [AI Singer](https://memotune.com/ai-singer): Generate vocal performances with AI singers for any song or lyrics.
- [Image to Music](https://memotune.com/image-to-music): Convert photos into original music tracks by interpreting visual mood, color, and scene.
- [AI Song Extender](https://memotune.com/ai-song-extender): Extend existing tracks with AI-generated continuations that match style and structure.
- [AI Instrumental Generator](https://memotune.com/ai-instrumental-generator): Create instrumental tracks across 20+ genres without vocals.
- [AI Music Replace](https://memotune.com/ai-music-replace): Replace specific sections of a song while keeping the rest intact.

## Music Styles

- [Music Styles Hub](https://memotune.com/styles): Browse 9 genre-specific AI music generators with style-tuned prompts and examples.
- [Jazz](https://memotune.com/styles/jazz): Generate jazz tracks — Swing, Bebop, Cool, Smooth, and Fusion styles.
- [Hip Hop](https://memotune.com/styles/hip-hop): Create hip hop tracks — boom bap, trap, drill, cloud rap.
- [Rock](https://memotune.com/styles/rock): Generate rock tracks — classic rock, punk, grunge, indie, progressive.
- [Lo-Fi](https://memotune.com/styles/lofi): Create warm lo-fi tracks — Chillhop, Jazz-Hop, Ambient Lo-fi.
- [EDM](https://memotune.com/styles/edm): Generate EDM tracks — house, techno, trance, dubstep, future bass.
- [K-Pop](https://memotune.com/styles/kpop): Create K-pop tracks — idol pop, K-R&B, K-ballad, dark concept.
- [Country](https://memotune.com/styles/country): Generate country tracks — honky tonk, bluegrass, outlaw, Nashville sound.
- [Rap](https://memotune.com/styles/rap): Create rap tracks — Boom Bap to Drill with custom lyrics and flow control.
- [Metal](https://memotune.com/styles/metal): Generate metal tracks — heavy metal, thrash, death metal, black metal.

## Company

- [Pricing](https://memotune.com/pricing): Three tiers (Basic, Creator, Premium) with 7-day money-back guarantee. Annual plans save 25-45%.
- [About Us](https://memotune.com/about-us): Team of three building AI music tools since 2022. Creator-first approach focused on personal, on-topic songs.
- [Contact](https://memotune.com/contact): Reach the MemoTune team for support, partnerships, or press inquiries.

## Key Facts

- Founded in 2022, public launch in 2023
- Small independent team of 3, based in Scotts Valley, California, USA
- 12 AI music tools covering creation, editing, and voice
- Supports 13 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese
- Privacy-first: prompts and lyrics are not shared publicly or used to train models
- Commercial licensing available on paid plans
